🎁 CODES: LAG, INFINITEBUG, FIRSTRALLY, CALLTHEPLAY
⚙️ Redeem them in Settings → Codes!

🏐 START YOUR HAIKYUU CAREER! 🏐
From an unknown rookie to the player everyone is watching. Your story starts on the court!

🎮 Create your player and choose your volleyball position.
⚡ Play in LIVE, call the shots in MANAGE, or enjoy the match in WATCH.
🔥 Roll styles and zones, unlock skills, and unleash your Flow!
📈 Train your stats, raise your Overall, and develop your own playing style.
🤝 Build bonds with teammates and face familiar rivals through your career story.
🏆 Earn your place on the team, compete in tournaments, and climb the rankings!

One more receive. One perfect set. Your chance to become a star.

👍 Like + favorite ⭐ to support the game!

A Haikyuu-inspired anime volleyball career game.

DISCLAIMER: This unofficial, fan-made game was created by Haikyuu! fans as a tribute to the anime and our community.
